verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.unstructured.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured Transform documentation index. The docs include a dedicated agent guide that tells agents which MCP server, SDK or API to prefer, and many docs pages are served as raw .md files that agents can read. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and no independent community corroboration of agents using these docs.
